verdict.rationale: MailerLite's API docs say developers can "retrieve campaign reports and link clicks," so campaign performance metrics can be pulled programmatically into an external warehouse or dashboard. Nothing shows API access to automation (flow) performance metrics; the custom reports feature appears to be in-app only. missing for 10: API retrieval of automation/flow performance metrics, detailed documentation of which campaign report fields are exposed, independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse/dashboard export

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
